name: WalletVerification
description: Verifies if a user owns a wallet on a given network

parameters.name: walletAddress
parameters.description: The wallet address to be verified. This address is used to reconstruct the expected message and compare it with the extracted address from the signature.

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: The network type to determine which verification method to use. Valid values are 'prime', 'vector', 'nexus', or 'cardano'.

parameters.name: signature
parameters.description: The signature data used for verification. For 'prime' and 'vector', this should include a hex-encoded 'signature' and 'key'. For 'nexus', it is an Ethereum-style signature string. For 'cardano', it is a CIP-30 COSESign1 hex string.

parameters.name: isTestnet
parameters.description: Optional flag used when the network is 'vector'. Indicates if the verification should use the testnet address format (true) or mainnet (false).

parameters.name: isStakingAddress
parameters.description: Optional flag used when the network is 'prime'. Indicates whether the provided walletAddress should be treated as a staking address.

parameters.name: customMessage
parameters.description: Optional custom message for verification. Used with 'cardano' network to specify a custom verification message instead of the default 'Connect:address' format.
